topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: You've got to be kidding me. Of all the teachers in this entire school, my kid ends up with the same one I had back when? I remember that class, the way this teacher just...made every day a challenge. I don’t know, I just can’t shake this sense that it’s a setup for some kind of ruthless cycle. I know I shouldn’t jump to conclusions, but how am I supposed to stay calm about this? I need to protect my kid, don’t I? This is supposed to be about their education, not a chance to relive my own troubled past. I’ve got to find a way to turn this around, make sure it’s not just a repeat of my story.
